input.goal: Mix all the ingredients except for the chicken. Pour into a large container and add the chicken thighs.

sub_goals.text: Get the bowl and open the chicken container
Separate, wash, and place the first batch of chicken pieces into the bowl
Separate, wash, and place the remaining chicken pieces into the bowl
Retrieve lemon and soy sauce, and pour soy sauce into the bowl
Squeeze the first lemon into the bowl and remove fallen seeds
Cut and squeeze another lemon into the bowl
Add oregano and spice mix to the bowl
Break the garlic head and peel the outer cover
Peel and chop the garlic cloves into the bowl

skills.object_recognition: L1: which object is in hand / being handled at the moment of the event
skills.spatial_near: L1: at the moment of the event, which of the listed objects is nearest to a reference object (3D positions from the dataset)
skills.spatial_side: L1: at the moment of the event, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost from the wearer's viewpoint
skills.object_location_at_time: L1: on which surface / fixture / container an object is put down at the event
skills.object_grounding: L1: localise the object of the event in a frame (bounding box)
skills.action_recognition: L2: what action (verb + object) the event is
skills.event_object_role: L2: which object is acted on, with which tool, to which destination in the event
skills.action_temporal_order: L2: the order of two actions shown close together inside one sub-goal
skills.sound_action_binding: L2: which action / object produced the sound heard
skills.object_state_change: L2: where an object was taken from and where it went in one movement
skills.sound_movement_binding: L2: which object movement coincides with the sound
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_near: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is nearest to a reference object
skills.sound_anchored_spatial_side: L2: at the moment of a sound, which listed object is leftmost / rightmost for the wearer

l3_relation_types.object_continuity: the same object / ingredient appears in an event of sub-goal k and an event of the ADJACENT sub-goal k+1; what happened to it between them (chopped broccoli -> in the pan)
l3_relation_types.state_change: how the state of an object differs between the two events (whole -> chopped, empty -> full, raw -> browned)
l3_relation_types.causal_prerequisite: the earlier event is a physical prerequisite of the later one (could not be done without it)
l3_relation_types.hidden_state: an appliance / container state was set in the earlier event and is not visible in the later segment; what is its state at the end of the later segment
l3_relation_types.spatial_end_state: after placements in the two events, which listed object ends nearest / farthest to a reference object (needs 3D records)

plan.goal: Mix all the ingredients except for the chicken. Pour into a large container and add the chicken thighs.

events.description: The bowl is placed on the counter.
events.relevance: prepares the container to receive the ingredients

events.description: The chicken container is opened.
events.relevance: provides access to the raw chicken

events.description: Chicken pieces are washed under running water.
events.relevance: cleans the first batch of chicken

events.description: The washed chicken pieces are placed into the bowl.
events.relevance: adds the first batch of chicken to the mixing bowl

events.description: The remaining chicken pieces are washed under the tap.
events.relevance: cleans the rest of the chicken

events.description: The remaining washed chicken is placed into the bowl.
events.relevance: completes adding all the chicken to the bowl

events.description: Vinegar is poured from its bottle into the bowl over the chicken.
events.relevance: adds the first liquid marinade ingredient

events.description: Soy sauce is poured into the bowl.
events.relevance: adds the second liquid marinade ingredient

events.description: A lemon half is squeezed over the bowl.
events.relevance: adds fresh lemon juice to the marinade

events.description: Fallen lemon seeds are picked out of the bowl.
events.relevance: removes unwanted seeds from the mixture

events.description: Another lemon is cut in half with a knife on a cutting board.
events.relevance: prepares the second lemon for squeezing

events.description: The newly cut lemon halves are squeezed into the bowl.
events.relevance: adds more lemon juice to the marinade

events.description: Rosemary is sprinkled into the bowl.
events.relevance: adds herbal flavoring to the marinade

events.description: Oregano is added to the bowl.
events.relevance: adds more herbs to the marinade

events.description: Spice mix is poured into the bowl.
events.relevance: adds dry spices to the marinade

events.description: A head of garlic is broken apart into individual cloves.
events.relevance: separates the cloves for peeling

events.description: The outer papery cover of the garlic is peeled off.
events.relevance: removes the inedible outer layers

events.description: Individual garlic cloves are peeled.
events.relevance: prepares the cloves for chopping

events.description: The peeled garlic cloves are chopped with a knife.
events.relevance: minces the garlic to release flavor

events.description: The chopped garlic is scraped into the bowl.
events.relevance: adds the final ingredient to the marinade

relations.ask: Why was the chicken placed in that specific location?
relations.answer_hint: The bowl was placed on the counter in the previous step to receive the chicken.

relations.ask: What is already in the bowl when the remaining chicken is added?
relations.answer_hint: The first batch of chicken was placed there previously.

relations.ask: What liquid is already in the bowl when the soy sauce is poured?
relations.answer_hint: Vinegar was poured into the bowl in the previous step.

relations.ask: What had to be done to the garlic before the individual cloves could be peeled?
relations.answer_hint: The head of garlic was broken apart into cloves.

relations.ask: How did the state of the garlic change before it was chopped?
relations.answer_hint: It went from being in a whole head with skin to separated, peeled cloves.

decision_points.why: Deciding to start washing and adding the first batch of chicken after preparing the containers.
Just continuing the exact same washing and placing process for the remaining chicken pieces.
Transitioning from handling raw chicken to adding the first liquid marinade ingredient.
Moving on to the next specific liquid ingredient (soy sauce).
Switching from pouring bottled liquids to squeezing fresh lemon.
Continuing to add lemon juice by preparing and squeezing a second lemon.
Transitioning from liquids and juices to dry herbs.
Continuing to add dry seasonings (oregano and spice mix).
Switching from adding ready-to-use spices to preparing fresh garlic.
Continuing the garlic preparation by peeling, chopping, and adding it.
The marinade ingredients are all added; deciding the task is complete.
